learning_outcomes: Developing comprehensive overview of basic topics in biomedical imaging & analysis
Deeper knowledge of a specific biomedical imaging and analysis application
Developing a biomedical image analysis system using public APIs
Conducting a literature survey and writing a report (for graduate students)
topics: Imaging Methods & Physics: Optical, X-ray, CT, MRI
Imaging Methods & Physics: PET, US, Fusion, Biology
Image Data Structure and Image Visualization
Image Segmentation: Watersheds, Level Sets, Graph
Group Project Work and Final Presentation

skills.evidence: This course, an introduction to biomedical imaging and analysis, covers two main components: physical image formation (e.g., imaging physics, 3D imaging, image formats, visualization)
computational data analysis (e.g., digital image processing, filtering, registration, segmentation, quantification)
Digital Image Filtering: Spatial Domain; Digital Image Filtering: Frequency Domain
Image Segmentation: Thresholding, Region Growing; Image Segmentation: Watersheds, Level Sets, Graph
Image Registration: Geometry-based Registration; Image Registration: Intensity-Based Registration
Image Quantification: Change Analysis, Classification
